contact_sources.quote:
Jung Lee - Managing Director at Guggenheim Partners
Description: I joined Guggenheim Investments in 2019 to focus on the firm’s corporate strategy and private investments. Guggenheim Investments is a global asset management and investment advisory division of Guggenheim Partners, with more than $255 billion in total assets across fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies. Prior to Guggenheim, I was an investment banker, having executed numerous M&A, strategic advisory and public and private capital raising assignments for clients [...] ## Skills
